name: ColorSlider
summary: Adjusts one channel of a color.

obligations: Expose a named color channel slider.
Expose disabled state and keyboard adjustment.

behavior: Arrow keys adjust one color channel.
Controlled and uncontrolled Core color strings are supported.

channel is red, green, blue, hue, saturation, lightness, brightness, or alpha, and colorSpace is rgb, hsl, or hsb. The channel must belong to colorSpace, or, when colorSpace is omitted, to the space of the effective color: an enclosing ColorPicker's color, otherwise value or defaultValue. Other pairs throw a TypeError.
Does not participate in forms and admits no name; use a named ColorField to submit a color.

onChange emits a CSS string in the slider's colour space: when colorSpace is set it decides the format in both directions (rgb gives rgba(r, g, b, a) even for an HSL value; hsl or hsb gives hsla(h, s%, l%, a) even for a hex value); otherwise the value's own space decides, rgba() for hex or RGB values and hsla() for HSL or HSB values.
accessibility: Expose a named color channel slider.
Expose disabled state and keyboard adjustment.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
